avoid_supplements.name: Valerian root
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and sedation; may potentiate respiratory depression risk
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue valerian root at least 24 hours before dexmedetomidine administration

avoid_supplements.name: Kava kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potentiates CNS depression and hepatotoxicity risk; additive sedative effects
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient to discontinue prior to treatment

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP2A6 and CYP2E1 induction may reduce dexmedetomidine efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Allow 2-week washout before dexmedetomidine use; monitor sedation level

caution_supplements.name: Melatonin
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive sedative effects; may enhance dexmedetomidine-induced somnolence
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; counsel patient on increased sedation risk

caution_supplements.name: Passionflower
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CNS depressant effects; additive with dexmedetomidine sedation
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive drowsiness; consider timing separation

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have stimulant properties that could antagonize dexmedetomidine effects
caution_supplements.action: Advise patient of potential reduced efficacy; monitor response

caution_foods.name: Caffeine-containing beverages
caution_foods.mechanism: Stimulant effects may partially antagonize dexmedetomidine's sedative action
caution_foods.action: Limit intake during treatment; advise patient to avoid large amounts

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP2E1 inhibition may increase dexmedetomidine levels slightly
caution_foods.action: Advise avoidance or consistent minimal intake; monitor for enhanced effects

monitoring_notes: Monitor vital signs closely including heart rate, blood pressure, and respiratory function as dexmedetomidine carries significant risks of bradycardia and hypotension. Assess hepatic function baseline and periodically, as primary metabolism occurs hepatically; use caution in hepatic impairment.
